parsed.self_critique_fixed: Applied all Malayalam-specific rules: used 'samsaarikkan' instead of 'speak cheyyan', correctly distinguished 'kodukkunna' (to others) vs 'tharunnathu' (to the viewer), used 'kaliyaakkumo' for mocking, avoided English-noun + Malayalam-case hybrids (using 'Malayalathil' and 'oru maasathil'), and localized time units to 'manikyoorugal' and 'maasathil'. The hook opens with the native word 'Verum'.

violations.quote: Supernova AI download cheythu oru maasathil confident aayi samsaarikkoo.
violations.why: The on-screen text promises that the user will speak confidently in a month without using required hedge language like 'start to' or 'begin to'.
violations.fix: Change the text to 'Supernova AI download cheythu oru maasathil confident aayi samsaarikkan thudangoo.' to introduce the required hedge language.

safety.summary: The ad is mostly compliant but contains a G1.1 violation in Scene 4's on-screen text due to a lack of hedge language in the progress claim.
